name: jsreverser-mcp

tools.name: analyze_target
tools.description: One-shot reverse workflow: collect code, run security/crypto analysis, optional deobfuscation, and hook timeline correlation.

tools.name: analyze_websocket_messages
tools.description: Group WebSocket messages by pattern/fingerprint and return stats plus sample indices for each type.

wsid.description: The wsid of the WebSocket connection to analyze.

direction.description: Only analyze messages in this direction.

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: breakpoint
tools.description: Manage JavaScript breakpoints: set, remove, or list active breakpoints.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

url.description: URL or URL pattern for action=set. Can be a partial match or regex pattern.

condition.description: Optional condition expression for action=set. Breakpoint triggers only when true.

isRegex.description: Whether action=set should treat url as a regex pattern.

breakpointId.description: Breakpoint ID for action=remove. Use breakpoint(action="list") to inspect active IDs.

tools.name: check_browser_health
tools.description: Check browser connectivity and active page readiness before running reverse workflows.

tools.name: click_element
tools.description: Click an element by selector.

tools.name: collect_code
tools.description: Collect JavaScript code from a page with smart modes (summary/priority/incremental/full).

tools.name: collection_diff
tools.description: Compare previous and current collected file summaries.

tools.name: console_message
tools.description: List console messages, or get one message by msgid.

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return for action=list. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return for action=list (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter action=list results by message type. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set true for action=list to include preserved messages from the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: create_hook
tools.description: RECOMMENDED: Create hook script for function/fetch/xhr/property/cookie/websocket/eval/timer. Hooks run without pausing page execution and are the preferred approach over breakpoints for monitoring and interception.

tools.name: deobfuscate_code
tools.description: AI-assisted JavaScript deobfuscation.

tools.name: detect_crypto
tools.description: Detect cryptographic algorithms/libraries from JavaScript source.

tools.name: diff_env_requirements
tools.description: Compare local runtime failures with observed browser capabilities and suggest the next environment patches.

tools.name: evaluate_on_callframe
tools.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context of a specific call frame while paused. This allows you to inspect variables and execute code in the paused scope.

frameIndex.description: The call frame index to evaluate in (0 = top frame, default: 0).

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the currently selected page. Returns the response as JSON
so returned values have to JSON-serializable.

pageIdx.description: Optional page index. When provided, runs in the target page main frame.

tools.name: export_rebuild_bundle
tools.description: Export a local Node rebuild bundle from observed reverse-engineering evidence.

tools.name: export_session_report
tools.description: Export current reverse-engineering session as JSON or Markdown.

tools.name: find_clickable_elements
tools.description: Find clickable buttons/links, optionally filtered by text.

tools.name: find_in_script
tools.description: Finds a string in a specific script and returns its exact line/column position with surrounding context. Ideal for setting breakpoints in minified files where the entire code is on one line.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

scriptId.description: The script ID to search in (from list_scripts).

query.description: The string to find in the script.

contextChars.description: Number of characters to show before and after the match (default: 100).

occurrence.description: Which occurrence to find (1 = first, 2 = second, etc.).

caseSensitive.description: Whether the search is case-sensitive (default: true).

tools.name: get_dom_structure
tools.description: Get DOM tree structure for current page.

tools.name: get_hook_data
tools.description: Get captured data for one hook or all hooks. Supports raw view and summary view for noise reduction.

tools.name: get_parameter_workflow
tools.description: Get one packaged parameter workflow by id or alias.

id.description: Workflow id or alias, for example `jd-h5st` or `h5st`.

tools.name: get_paused_info
tools.description: Gets information about the current paused state including call stack, current location, and scope variables. Use this after a breakpoint is hit to understand the execution context.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

includeScopes.description: Whether to include scope variables (default: true).

tools.name: get_performance_metrics
tools.description: Get page performance metrics from Performance API.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Read one packaged reference doc, or return its compact summary.

tools.name: get_reference_route
tools.description: Route by stage, topic, or natural-language query to the most relevant reference docs.

tools.name: get_request_initiator
tools.description: Gets the JavaScript call stack that initiated a network request. This helps trace which code triggered an API call.

requestId.description: The request ID (from network_request with action=list) to get the initiator for.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

taskId.description: Optional reverse task ID for writing durable evidence artifacts.

taskSlug.description: Optional reverse task slug used when opening the task artifact directory.

targetUrl.description: Optional target page URL associated with the reverse task.

goal.description: Optional reverse-engineering goal for the task artifact.

tools.name: get_script_source
tools.description: Gets the source code of a JavaScript script by its script ID. Supports line range (for normal files) or character offset (for minified single-line files). Use list_scripts first to find the script ID.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

scriptId.description: The script ID (from list_scripts) to get the source code for.

startLine.description: Start line number (1-based). Use for multi-line files.

endLine.description: End line number (1-based). Use for multi-line files.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (0-based). Use for minified single-line files.

length.description: Number of characters to return when using offset (default: 1000).

tools.name: get_storage
tools.description: Gets browser storage data including cookies, localStorage, and sessionStorage.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

filter.description: Optional filter string to match against keys/names.

tools.name: get_websocket_message
tools.description: Gets a single WebSocket message by its frame index. Use get_websocket_messages or analyze_websocket_messages first to find the frame index.

wsid.description: The wsid of the WebSocket connection.

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: get_websocket_messages
tools.description: Gets messages for a WebSocket connection. IMPORTANT: For binary/protobuf messages (like live streaming), use analyze_websocket_messages FIRST to understand message types, then use groupId parameter to filter specific types. Default mode shows summary only.

wsid.description: The wsid of the WebSocket connection.

groupId.description: Filter by group ID (A, B, C, ...). Get group IDs from analyze_websocket_messages first.

pageIdx.description: Page number (0-based).

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

show_content.description: Set to true to show full message payload. Default false (summary only) to avoid large binary output.

tools.name: hook_function
tools.description: Recommended default for reverse engineering: hook a function and log calls/args/results without pausing execution.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

target.description: The function to hook. Can be: global function name ("fetch"), object method ("XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open"), or path ("window.app.api.request").

logArgs.description: Whether to log function arguments (default: true).

logResult.description: Whether to log return value (default: true).

logStack.description: Whether to log call stack (default: false).

hookId.description: Custom identifier for this hook. Used to unhook later. Defaults to target name.

tools.name: inject_hook
tools.description: Inject an existing hook into the current page.

tools.name: inject_preload_script
tools.description: Register a JavaScript snippet that will run on future document loads before page scripts execute. Use this for preload hooks, environment patches, and early instrumentation.

script.description: JavaScript source to register for future document loads.

tools.name: inject_stealth
tools.description: Inject anti-detection stealth scripts to current page.

tools.name: inspect_object
tools.description: Deeply inspects a JavaScript object, showing its properties, prototype chain, and methods. Useful for understanding object structure.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate and inspect (e.g., "window.app", "document.body", "myObject").

depth.description: How deep to inspect nested objects (default: 2).

showPrototype.description: Whether to show prototype chain (default: true).

tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: Lists all frames (including iframes) in the current page as a tree. Shows frame index, name, and URL. Use select_frame to switch execution context to a specific frame.

tools.name: list_hooks
tools.description: Lists all active function hooks.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

tools.name: list_parameter_workflows
tools.description: List packaged parameter workflows that can guide reverse-engineering and rebuild steps.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: Lists all JavaScript scripts loaded in the current page. Returns script ID, URL, and source map information. Use this to find scripts before setting breakpoints or searching.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

filter.description: Optional filter string to match against script URLs (case-insensitive partial match).

tools.name: list_stealth_features
tools.description: List available stealth feature toggles.

tools.name: list_stealth_presets
tools.description: List available stealth presets.

tools.name: list_websocket_connections
tools.description: List all WebSocket connections. After getting wsid, use analyze_websocket_messages(wsid) FIRST to understand message patterns before viewing individual messages.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of connections to return. When omitted, returns all connections.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

urlFilter.description: Filter connections by URL. Only connections containing this substring will be returned.

includePreservedConnections.description: Set to true to return the preserved connections over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: monitor_events
tools.description: Monitors DOM events on a specified element or window. Events will be logged to console.

selector.description: CSS selector for element to monitor, or "window"/"document" (default: window).

events.description: Specific events to monitor (e.g., ["click", "keydown"]). If not specified, monitors common events.

monitorId.description: Custom ID for this monitor. Used to stop monitoring later.

taskId.description: Optional reverse task ID for writing durable evidence artifacts.

taskSlug.description: Optional reverse task slug used when opening the task artifact directory.

targetUrl.description: Optional target page URL associated with the reverse task.

goal.description: Optional reverse-engineering goal for the task artifact.

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Navigates the currently selected page to a URL, or performs back/forward/reload navigation. Waits for DOMContentLoaded event (not full page load). Default timeout is 10 seconds.

pageIdx.description: Optional page index to navigate. Defaults to the currently selected page.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: network_request
tools.description: List network requests, or get one request by reqid.

reqid.description: Request id for action=get. If omitted, uses the selected request in DevTools when available.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return for action=list. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return for action=list (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

targetPageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter action=list results by resource type. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set true for action=list to include preserved requests from the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Creates a new page and navigates to the specified URL. Waits for DOMContentLoaded event (not full page load). Default timeout is 10 seconds.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Pauses JavaScript execution at the current point. Use this to interrupt running code.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: query_dom
tools.description: Query one or multiple elements by CSS selector.

tools.name: recommend_parameter_workflow
tools.description: Recommend the closest packaged parameter workflow from a keyword, alias, or short natural-language query.

query.description: Keyword or short query, for example `h5st` or `query token sign`.

tools.name: record_reverse_evidence
tools.description: Append structured reverse-engineering evidence to a task artifact log.

tools.name: remove_hook
tools.description: Remove a hook by id.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resumes JavaScript execution after being paused at a breakpoint. Execution continues until the next breakpoint or completion.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: risk_panel
tools.description: Build a combined risk score from analyzer, crypto detector and hook signals.

tools.name: search_in_scripts
tools.description: Search in collected script cache with regex pattern.

tools.name: search_in_sources
tools.description: Searches for a string or regex pattern in all loaded JavaScript sources. Returns matching lines with script ID, URL, and line number. Use get_script_source with startLine/endLine to view full context around matches.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

query.description: The search query (string or regex pattern).

caseSensitive.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

isRegex.description: Whether to treat the query as a regular expression.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 30).

maxLineLength.description: Maximum characters per line preview (default: 150). Set to 0 for full lines.

excludeMinified.description: Skip minified files (files with very long lines). Default: true.

urlFilter.description: Only search scripts whose URL contains this string (case-insensitive).

tools.name: select_frame
tools.description: Selects a frame (by index from list_frames) as the execution context for evaluate_script, hook_function, inspect_object, and other tools that run JavaScript in the page.

frameIdx.description: The frame index from list_frames. 0 = main frame.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageIdx.description: The index of the page to select. Call list_pages to list pages.

tools.name: session_state
tools.description: Manage in-memory session snapshots: save, restore, list, delete, dump, or load.

tools.name: set_breakpoint_on_text
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint on specific code (function name, statement, etc.) by searching for it and automatically determining the exact position. Works with both normal and minified files. NOTE: Prefer hook_function for monitoring function calls — it captures args/results without pausing execution. Use this only when you need to inspect local variables at a specific code location.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

text.description: The code text to find and set breakpoint on (e.g., "function myFunc", "fetchData(", "apiCall").

urlFilter.description: Only search in scripts whose URL contains this string (case-insensitive).

occurrence.description: Which occurrence to break on (1 = first, 2 = second, etc.).

condition.description: Optional condition expression. Breakpoint only triggers when this evaluates to true.

tools.name: set_user_agent
tools.description: Set custom user-agent for active page.

tools.name: step_into
tools.description: Steps into the next function call. Use this to enter and debug function bodies.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: step_out
tools.description: Steps out of the current function, continuing until the function returns. Use this to quickly exit a function.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: step_over
tools.description: Steps over to the next statement, treating function calls as a single step. Use this to move through code without entering function bodies.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

tools.name: stop_monitor
tools.description: Stops an event monitor.

tools.name: summarize_code
tools.description: Summarize one code file, multiple files, or project-level context.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

pageIdx.description: Optional browser page index. Defaults to the currently selected page.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: trace_function
tools.description: Traces calls to a function by its name in the source code. Works for ANY function including module-internal functions (webpack/rollup bundled). Uses "logpoints" (conditional breakpoints) to log arguments without pausing execution.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

functionName.description: The function name to trace. Will search for "function NAME" or "NAME = function" or "NAME(" patterns.

urlFilter.description: Only search in scripts matching this URL pattern.

logArgs.description: Whether to log function arguments (default: true).

pause.description: Whether to actually pause execution (default: false, just logs).

traceId.description: Custom ID for this trace. Used to identify in logs.

taskId.description: Optional reverse task ID for writing durable evidence artifacts.

taskSlug.description: Optional reverse task slug used when opening the task artifact directory.

targetUrl.description: Optional target page URL associated with the reverse task.

goal.description: Optional reverse-engineering goal for the task artifact.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into an input element.

tools.name: understand_code
tools.description: Analyze code structure/business/security with AI + static analysis.

tools.name: unhook_function
tools.description: Removes a previously installed function hook.

hookId.description: The hook ID to remove (from hook_function).

tools.name: wait_for_element
tools.description: Wait for selector to appear.

tools.name: xhr_breakpoint
tools.description: Set or remove an XHR/Fetch breakpoint by URL substring match.

pageIdx.description: Browser page index to inspect (0-based). When omitted, uses the currently selected page.

url.description: URL pattern to set/remove breakpoint for (partial match).
